sinks.name: TA_InvokeCommandEntryPoint

sinks.name: TA_InvokeCommandEntryPoint
sinks.reason: Selects which command logic executes, controlling security-relevant code paths.

sinks.name: TA_InvokeCommandEntryPoint
sinks.reason: Determines interpretation of parameters and memory references, affecting how untrusted input is parsed/handled.

sinks.name: TA_InvokeCommandEntryPoint

sinks.name: TA_OpenSessionEntryPoint
